instruction: A candid wide-angle documentary photograph in a motion capture studio with a red carpet. On the left, the bearded man in a black t-shirt and blue shorts (R1) stands facing right, extending his right arm to touch the chest of the woman in a white t-shirt and blue jeans (R2), who stands upright on the right facing him. The background shows white walls, a radiator, and bright overhead lighting.
elements: R1 extends his right arm toward R2's chest
R1 touches R2's chest rather than R2 touching R1's chest
R2 receives the chest touch while standing upright facing R1
R1 and R2 face each other during the contact
motion capture studio setting with a red carpet

questions.q: Is R1 extending his right arm to touch R2's chest, rather than R2 extending an arm to touch R1's chest?
Does the contact originate from R1's right arm and land on R2's chest, rather than originating from R2 and landing on R1?
questions.element: direction of physical contact from R1 to R2

questions.q: Is R2 the person whose chest is being touched by R1, rather than R1 being the person whose chest is being touched by R2?
questions.element: R2 as recipient of R1's chest touch
